narrator_hint: seventh-storyteller / ending routes: several characters; work out the speaker from context

rows.en:
...I was so appalled I couldn't say a word.
He really tried to kill me for a reason like that?
Just because some water splashed on his pants?
And it wasn't even on purpose. It just happened by accident.
On top of that, I don't even remember whether it ever happened.
And yet he held a grudge over it and tried to kill me?
...Is this guy out of his mind?
A fresh wave of terror washed over me.
Do I really have to die for people like these?{p}

"Go on, kill me! Why don't you just kill me! Ptui!"
Kazama spat at me.{p}What should I do?
Maybe what I'd said earlier had set him off. Kazama wasn't backing down from his defiant attitude.{p}What should I do?
Hit him
Get tough with him
Apologize and get him to calm down

"...You want to try dying?"
I was going to die soon.
I was going to die, all because of scum like these.
Why should I have to apologize to a guy like this?
"You told me to kill you a minute ago. Want me to kill you, just like you asked?
Even if you die, there are plenty of other ways to find the ampoule."
I tried to slam Kazama's head into the cabinet again.
This time into the other cabinet, the one with its glass still intact...
"...Stop! I'm sorry! I'll tell you anything!"
Kazama shrieked, his voice cracking.
"You should've said that from the start. Where's the ampoule?"
"...Th-that's something only Hino knows."
"You want to die?"
"It's true! It really is! I really don't know!"
It looked like he truly didn't know.
...If I believed what he said, my only options were to search for the ampoule or to ask Hino directly.
There was no point in going after any of the others.{p}What should I do?

I yanked the cord out of an electric drill in the art room and tied Kazama up with it.
Then I tried to stuff a rag into his mouth.{p}

"Stop! That's filthy! What are you doing to my beautiful face?!"
"Shut up! Be grateful I'm not killing you!"
I shoved the dirty rag into Kazama's mouth.
He mumbled and struggled, but he soon gave up and went quiet.{p}
Right. Time to make my move.

I searched the tool shelves.
There was no ampoule.
But there were plenty of saws, hammers and the like.
"...Looks like I'm going to end up fighting them."
I rummaged through the tool shelves.
I wanted to take the whole toolbox, but it looked heavy and would only get in my way.
From it, I picked out a hammer and a saw.{p}

Two-sword style.
I felt like Miyamoto Musashi.
This really was a matter of life or death.
I jammed the hammer and the saw into my belt.{p}Now, what should I do?
I headed for the art prep room next to the art room.{p}
What should I do?
Search the cabinets
Search the desk
Go back to the art room
I decided to check the cabinets.{p}

The cabinets were full of paintings, apparently done by art club students.
There was no way the ampoule would be in a place like this, I supposed.{p}

...Huh?
Among them, I found a portrait.
"It's Iwashita."
I had no idea who had painted it, but the person on that canvas was unmistakably Akemi Iwashita.
"This might come in handy."
I decided to take the painting with me.{p}What should I do next?
I went back to the art room.{p}What should I do?
I decided to go to the old school building.{p}

...The old school building.
Even in the state I was in, the old school building still scared me.
There was no electricity in the old school building, so unless I had a flashlight, there was no way I could search it.
I didn't have a flashlight.{p}What should I do?
Should I go inside the old school building anyway?
Go in
Go somewhere else

All the same, I went into the pitch-dark old school building.
...It was no use.
I couldn't tell left from right, not even close.
...I'd better give up.{p}
Where should I go?

That's it!
There should be a teacher on duty in the night-duty room!
I didn't know which teacher it was, but I'd go and see.
If I explained what was going on, maybe something could be done?
...No, would I just get yelled at?
It was all or nothing. I'd go and see!{p}
The door was locked.{p}

What should I do?
Should I try to get in?
Or should I go somewhere else?
Unlock the door
Go somewhere else
I opened the door with the bunch of keys I'd brought from the faculty room.{p}
The TV was on.{p}The teacher was watching it, back turned to me.
Run over to the teacher
Take a good look around the room

Something was wrong.
The teacher was right there inside, yet didn't answer?
...Could something have happened?
Without thinking, I looked around the room.
There was nowhere in this room for anyone to hide.
I called out once more.
"...Teacher?"
But still no answer came back.
I ran over and put my hand on the teacher's shoulder.
And then...
The teacher slumped limply over.
"Aaagh!"
The teacher's throat had been slit wide open, straight across.{p}

I turned around to see Shindo lunging at me from the doorway.
He had a knife in his hand.
"Whoa!"
I dodged it by a hair.
The knife grazed my cheek.
It burned!
I pulled the hammer and the saw out of my belt.{p}

Seeing that, Shindo grinned.
"Packing some pretty dangerous stuff there, huh?
You planning to take me on with that?"
Shindo held his knife ready, watching me closely.
He looked like he was well used to fighting.
If I charged in carelessly, I'd be the one who got taken down.
But the same went for Shindo.
We each watched the other, waiting.{p}

"Did you kill the teacher?"
"Yeah. They were in my way."
This guy... he kills a person and doesn't feel a thing?
If this kept up, time would just keep slipping away.{p}
What should I do?
Rush in close to him
Throw the hammer at him
Apologize
Run for now

"Guhh!"
I quickly snatched up the knife he had dropped and pressed it against his throat.
Shindo was trembling.
Then he went still.
Was he waiting for me to slip up, or had he given up?{p}
What should I do?
Press the knife in harder
Ask why he's trying to kill me
Ask where the ampoule is
Let him go
Tie him up

"Where's the ampoule?"
"Beats me."
I pressed the blade against him.
"Lie to me and I'll kill you. I don't have much time left.
I don't mind killing you and taking you down with me."
Cold sweat beaded on his forehead.
"...I really don't know. Only Hino knows."{p}
...So what Kazama said was true after all.{p}

"Why are you trying to kill me? I've never done anything to deserve your revenge!"
At that, Shindo's eyes flew wide open, then he gave me a look of contempt and snorted.
"...Hmph. You say you don't know me?
Figures, for a lowlife like you.
I bet you don't even remember the time I was out recruiting new students for my club."
I frowned.
Club recruitment...
I'd talked with plenty of upperclassmen, but I didn't remember Shindo's face.
"That look says you don't remember.
Not that I expected you to.
I called out to you again and again.
But you ignored me and just walked off."
"And?"
"That's it."
"...That's it?"
I couldn't believe what Shindo was saying.
"That's more than enough reason to kill you, isn't it? Die!"
Shindo's words shocked me so badly that I let my guard slip for an instant.
Shindo didn't miss it.{p}
He threw me off, grabbed the hammer I'd thrown, raised it high and came at me.{p}

"Waaah!"
On instinct, I yanked the TV cord that was right by my hand.
"Ah!"
Shindo tripped over the cord and fell.{p}
Right then, I pulled the cord out and tied Shindo's hands behind his back.{p}

"Stop it! Let go of me!"
...I didn't even feel like killing a guy like this.
Once I'd tied Shindo up, I pulled a sock off the teacher's body sprawled on the floor and stuffed it into Shindo's mouth.
"Mmph!"{p}

Then I slapped Shindo across the face.
"Shut up! That's all you deserve.
I'll hand you over to the police later. You murderer!"
I gagged Shindo and tied him to a pillar.
Then I decided to take the knife Shindo had been carrying.{p}
This looked like it'd be easier to use than a hammer or a saw.{p}

Now, what should I do?
I had to search the night-duty room.
Check the sink
Check the closet
Check the shelf
Go somewhere else

I checked the shelf.
There was no sign of the ampoule.
But there was a flashlight sitting there.
Some places had no working lights.
With this, I could manage places like that.
I decided to take the flashlight with me.{p}What should I do?
All right, I'd go somewhere else.{p}Where should I go?

The newspaper club room☆
That's right, it might be there.
It was the last place I'd ever think to search.
Hino being Hino, I was sure of it.
He'd be out to outsmart me, no doubt.
...Was anyone still left in the newspaper club room?
No, judging from the situation, they were all out looking for me.
Did they think they were having fun on some kind of manhunt?{p}

...No one was there.
Now, where should I search?
Search the shelf
Search the table
Go somewhere else

I searched the shelves.
There was nothing in particular...{p}

"Aagh!"
Suddenly, a searing pain shot through my leg.
I looked down and saw Iwashita sinking her teeth into my leg.
...Had she been hiding under the table?{p}

"I'll kill you!"
Hair flying wildly, Iwashita lunged at me.
She was gripping a rope in her hands.
Was that the rope that had tied my hands and feet?
I had no time to regain my balance.
As I fell, the rope looped around my neck.
"Die!"
Then Iwashita pulled with all her strength.
"Ghhk!"
The rope cinched tight around my throat in an instant.
In agony, I flung away what I'd been holding.
But at that very moment, the rope around my neck slackened.{p}

...I see.
She'd been startled by the portrait of Iwashita I was holding.
I hurriedly pulled the rope off my neck and reached for the portrait.{p}What should I do?
Threaten her
Hit her
Ask why she's trying to kill me
Ask where the ampoule is
Let her go
Tie her up
I took the knife out of my pocket and pressed it against the portrait.{p}
"How about I rip this painting to shreds?★"{p}

"Stop!"
Iwashita screamed.
Just as I'd thought, this painting meant a great deal to her.
Looking ready to burst into tears, Iwashita fell to her knees and pressed her hands together as if in prayer.
"Please! Just don't lay a hand on that painting!"
That was when it happened.{p}

"Waaaaaaagh!"
Someone attacked me from behind.{p}What should I do?
Jump aside
Use the portrait as a shield
Swing the knife around
I spun around on reflex and thrust out Iwashita's portrait.{p}
A chisel plunged into the portrait.{p}

My attacker was Arai.
"Time to die, {a}!"
Arai slashed the portrait open with the chisel in his hand.
Then he peered out through the hole in the canvas, looking delighted.{p}

"Eeeeeeeek!☆"
Arai slashing the portrait and Iwashita screaming happened at the same instant.{p}

"I'll kill you!"
Then, her face twisted with rage, Iwashita attacked.
...Not me, but Arai.
Arai must never have seen that coming.
As the two of them grappled, the chisel ended up in Iwashita's hand.
"Die! Die! Drop dead!"{p}

Arai's white shirt was turning red with blood.
And as his shirt grew redder, his face grew paler and paler.
He was no longer breathing.
"{a}!"
Suddenly, Iwashita turned to face me.
One look at her face, and I couldn't move.
I had never seen a human face so horribly transformed.
Iwashita was going to kill me.
Then, without warning, Iwashita drove the chisel into her own face.
"If this painting is gone, I'll die too.
The senior I loved painted it for me.
My senior graduated, leaving this painting behind, so I killed them.
I never forgive anyone who leaves me behind.
...{a}, I'll go on ahead and wait for you in Hell.
Your life will be over soon too, you know."
I couldn't stop her.{p}

Iwashita stabbed her own face over and over with the chisel, and at last drove it into her throat.
"Hhhhhhhh..."
A hoarse rasp leaked from her mouth, blood sprayed from her gaping throat, and Iwashita died.
The club room was drenched red with the blood of the two of them.
Iwashita's dead face looked exactly like the face in the slashed portrait.{p}

"Y-You've got to be kidding... They're all... they're all out of their minds."
My legs gave out, and I slumped to the floor of the club room, now a sea of blood.{p}

Because water splashed on a guy's pants?
Because I didn't answer when someone called out to me?
I'm going to be killed just for that?
...No doubt Iwashita and Arai had no real reason to kill me either.{p}

...They're all murderers.
I just happened to become the sacrifice of a pack of killers.
...Am I going to die?
...Am I really going to die?
...F-For now, I have to get up.
...F-For now, I have to find the ampoule.
"Aagh!"
My legs were shaking and the floor was slick, and I couldn't get up.
The moment I lost my balance, a notebook tumbled off the shelf.{p}

On the notebook were the words "Grudge Notebook."{p}...What is this?
Should I read it?
Read it
Better not read it

With my blood-soaked hands, I turned the pages.
Inside were petty gripes written by Hino, Shindo and the others.
Spilled coffee on me.
Got barked at by a dog.
Hid my shoes.
Told a stupid joke.
Tapped me on the shoulder out of nowhere.
Was noisy when I was sleepy.
Has a vulgar laugh.
Never apologized.
Didn't pay interest on the money I lent.
Wouldn't let me copy their notes.
...Along with such trivial complaints, many people's names were written down.{p}

An execution list...
I held my breath and read on.{p}

Yo, {a}.
I figured you'd come back to the newspaper club, so I'm leaving this notebook on the shelf for you.
If you find it, read it carefully.
These are the sinners we've killed so far.
The reasons you're going to be killed are many.
You've committed crimes that would justify the death penalty.
The charges are as follows.{p}

You splashed water on Kazama's pants.
You ignored Shindo when he called out to you.
Arai was standing on the train, and you didn't give him your seat.
You looked at Iwashita and laughed.
You bought the last of the cafeteria curry, so Hosoda didn't get to eat any.
Fukuzawa stepped on gum you spat out.
And my dad works at the same company as your dad.
Your dad got promoted there, so my dad couldn't.
That's why you deserve to die.
Hino.{p}

...I turned to the last page.
At the very end of the notebook, this was written:
A band of people chosen to make this world a paradise.
The Murder Club... it said.
The Murder Club?
I've never heard of a club like that.
Are all of them members of this Murder Club?
I flung the notebook away.{p}
The notebook landed in the sea of blood with a wet splat.{p}
...I'm tired.

...What now?
Do I still have the will to keep searching for the ampoule?{p}With that Murder Club crowd against me.
I can't lose now
I don't care anymore

I stood up.
No way am I dying here.
Find your courage and stand tall!{p}Now, what should I do?
Where should I go?

I headed for the school gate.
If I set even one foot outside the school, I'm dead.{p}

I stood in front of the school gate.
Hino must be watching me from somewhere.{p}What should I do?
Should I try going outside?
Go out through the school gate
Go somewhere else

I can't leave through the school gate.
There's no point in coming here yet.{p}
Where should I go?
I decided to go back to the art room once more.{p}
To ask Kazama about the Murder Club.{p}

...In the art room, Kazama was dead.
"...My God."
My knees buckled, and a sigh escaped my lips.
Kazama's head lay where it had carelessly rolled, and on the floor, written in blood, were the words:
Death to the losers!
...Did Hino kill him?{p}
At this rate, Shindo has probably been killed too.{p}
What should I do?
I decided to go to the old school building.{p}

...The old school building.
Even in my current state, the old school building scares me.
There's no electricity in the old school building, so without a flashlight, there'd be no way to search it.
Luckily, I have the flashlight I picked up in the night-duty room.
But searching a building this huge without a single clue is next to impossible.
I gave up and decided to go somewhere else.{p}
Where should I go?

I decided to go to the nurse's office.
If you hide medicine, you hide it where the medicine is.
That's just common sense.
I hurried to the nurse's office.{p}
The door was locked.{p}

I undid the lock with the bunch of keys I'd brought from the faculty room.
I went into the nurse's office.{p}
...Where should I search?
Search around the beds
Search the medicine cabinet
Search the cupboard
Go somewhere else
I'll search the medicine cabinet.{p}

...It's locked.
Only the school nurse should have the key to this.{p}What should I do?
Break it open?
Break it open
Give up

What am I hesitating for?
This is life or death!{p}

I smashed the glass of the medicine cabinet.
Then I rummaged through it.
Among the bottles of cold medicine and stomach medicine stood row after row of little vials just like that ampoule.
With so many of them, I couldn't tell which one it was.
What should I do?
Should I drink them all?
They're kept in the nurse's office, so they can't be poison.{p}

"Raaaaaagh!"
That was when it happened.{p}

Flinging the bed aside, Hosoda emerged from behind it.
Damn it.
I should have checked the bed!
His huge body quaking, he charged at me.{p}

My knife's gone!
I left it behind at the newspaper club.{p}
What should I do?
Grab the screwdriver in my pocket
Grab a shard of broken glass
Dodge
